@graph.name: Air fryer vs oven: running cost — Air Fryer Toolkit
@graph.description: What an oven recipe costs to cook in an air fryer and in the oven, at your electricity price. Estimated from measured energy in Which?’s lab tests, not wattage × time.

mainEntity.name: Is an air fryer cheaper to run than an oven?

acceptedAnswer.text: For one batch, yes. In Which?’s lab test it used 53% to 69% less energy than the oven for each of the four foods. Source: Which?, 23 October 2026.

mainEntity.name: Why not just multiply the wattage by the time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because the element cycles once the appliance is hot, so wattage × time overstates the energy: 1.5 to 3.2 times for Which?’s oven. Source: Which?, 23 October 2026; oven rating from the retailer listing.
When you cook a lot at once. Which?: “an oven may still be the most economical choice when cooking for a crowd.” Source: Which?, 23 October 2026.

mainEntity.name: Does the standing charge change the answer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is a fixed daily amount, 54.83p a day under the UK price cap for 1 Oct – 31 Dec 2026, paid whether you cook or not, so it is the same with either appliance. Source: Ofgem.

Yes. Which?’s times and kWh include preheating, so the defaults add 10 minutes for the oven and 2 to 4 for the air fryer, more at higher settings; set the air fryer’s to zero if yours needs none. Source: Which?, 23 October 2026.
